{{Top|leg}}
The '''PN-4 sensor component''' was produced by [[Carbanti United Electronics/Legends|Carbanti United Electronics]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Using technology originally designed for deep space exploration missions, the component boosted the sensor range of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]].
